The box plot above shows the distribution of the number of home runs hit in one season by each of $9$ players on the baseball team. What is the range of the number of home runs hit by the $9$ players?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The box plot shows the distribution of the number of home runs hit by $9$ players. The leftmost part of the box plot, the minimum value, represents the fewest number of home runs hit by any of the $9$ players. The minimum value is $4$. The rightmost part of the box plot, the maximum value, represents the greatest number of home runs hit by any of the $9$ players. The maximum value is $10$. Therefore, the range of the number of home runs hit by the $9$ players is $10-4=6$.
